Results.ReviewText: I had previously purchased an off brand from a big box store and the quality wasn't there, it started to fall apart shortly after I purchased it, so I had to get rid of it. So, I bought the E-210 Gas Grill, the quality of a Weber Grill is the best, the thickness of the metal used is heavy duty, the quality of the paint high end, the grids are heavy duty, so is the thermometer, it's the perfect size for 2 people or a small family, and still, I cooked up 12 burgers for a family event with no problem, and the size saves on gas usage.  I also like the propane tank meter and it is easy to clean. I won't buy anything else in the future, if I ever need to buy another gas grill.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned this spirit E210 for eight years, and I’ve generally had a really great experience. I’ve owned other Weber grills for about 30 years all total. This unit I currently have has rusted through the base, including one of the casters, and the grate insert cracked in half during normal cleaning. I have kept the grilled covered during non use periods. The repair parts for the base, caster and grate were well in excess of $200.  I contacted Weber customer service and they offered a 10% discount on the parts ordered through their website, which I didn’t think was adequate given the age of the grill and cost of the replacement parts.

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
